brief: Build a food delivery service. Customers browse restaurants, place orders, track a courier, and cancel an order before preparation. Restaurant managers update menus; couriers update delivery status.
policy: Cancellation is only allowed before preparation starts. Every delivery status change must be auditable.

brief: Build a university library system. Students search books, reserve copies, borrow and return books, and view due dates. Librarians manage the catalog and approve borrowing.
policy: Reservations expire after 48 hours. A student may have at most three active loans.

brief: Build an inventory system. Warehouse staff receive stock, transfer stock between locations, perform stock counts, and view low-stock alerts. Managers approve adjustment requests.
policy: Transfers and adjustments must preserve stock ledger history. Negative inventory requires manager review.

brief: Design an appointment system using synthetic clinic data. Receptionists maintain appointment slots; patients book, reschedule and cancel appointments. Clinicians view their schedule.
policy: A slot cannot be booked twice. Cancelling within 24 hours records a late cancellation reason.

brief: Build a campus resource booking portal. Students find rooms and equipment, reserve time slots and cancel bookings. Administrators approve restricted equipment requests and manage resource availability.
policy: Conflicting reservations must be rejected. Restricted equipment cannot be issued without administrator approval.
